full_script: You're a casino owner, and you have a problem. People don't like losing their money to you. Here's how you fix it. Take down all the clocks, block out the windows, and rearrange your floor to have a maze-like layout. Now their sense of time and direction starts to blur. Next, the critical move: replace real money with chips. It is so much harder to track how much you're down when it is just abstract colored tokens. Before they leave, hand them free drinks. Now they feel valued, and alcohol isn't exactly famous for improving risk management. When they lose big, stop them and hand them a shiny VIP loyalty card. They are now premium customers eligible for free hotel suites. And all they had to do was lose their entire paycheck.
